recipe.variant: RealESRGAN_x4plus per frame, 4x, audio and fps passed through: the official 'Video Upscale: Real-ESRGAN' template, as is
recipe.from_template: utility-gan_upscaler (2026-01-26): LoadVideo -> GetVideoComponents -> ImageUpscaleWithModel(RealESRGAN_x4plus.safetensors) -> CreateVideo(images, audio, fps) -> SaveVideo('video/ComfyUI', auto, auto).

upscale_model.note: fastest alternative: realesr-general-x4v3.pth (compact SRVGG, 4.9 MB); 2x: RealESRGAN_x2plus.pth; anime frames: 4xHFA2kLUDVAESwinIR_light.pth

video.note: the clip; frames, audio and fps come out of GetVideoComponents, audio and fps pass through to CreateVideo; the model only touches the frames

recipe.defaults_note: Per-frame GAN upscale: 'It can't create new detail like diffusion can, but it's much faster'. No temporal model, so expect shimmer on video (the flicker rule warns); the -2x variant averages it down, SeedVR2 removes it.

vram_evidence.usage: NOT FOUND (internal 512-px tiling with OOM back-off; the whole frame batch is held as IMAGE tensors, so long clips are RAM-bound)

verify: PASSED offline structural check against the v0.35.0 registry on 2026-10-01 (classes, input keys incl. dynamic combos, links/types, enums, ranges, output node). Not yet run on a box.

The offline validator accepts only .safetensors/.gguf/.pt model names, so the recipe names a .safetensors build; the .pth models in profile.files are drop-in swaps on the box (ComfyUI loads .pth through spandrel) via the upscale_model port.
